description: List threads from the Canton Network governance mailing lists (lists.sync.global groups: cip-discuss, cip-vote, cip-announce, grants-discuss, validator-announce, tokenomics-announce, supervalidator-announce). Filter by group, CIP number, or date. Canton-only. This is the EMAIL/mailing-list channel. Distinct from the web forum (get_discussion) and GitHub Discussions (list_github_discussions). Returns thread metadata only; use get_mailing_thread for message bodies.

cip_id.description: CIP number filter, e.g. "0117". Returns only threads tagged with this CIP.

group.description: Restrict to one of the 7 indexed groups.

limit.description: How many threads to return. Default 20, max 100.

offset.description: Skip this many before returning, for paging past the limit. The response states the full count and echoes the offset used.

name: list_mailing_threads
